video_title: Postgame Media Availability with Coach Daigneault | OKC Thunder | October 26, 2026

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Giddey and Jalen Williams' development and impact on the team
quotes.excerpt: The minutes we got from Josh and Jalen in particular were huge, just a great testament to the work.
quotes.quote: The minutes we got from Josh and Jalen in particular were huge, just a great testament to the work they've put in since they've been on the ground here. Plus a die, from Summer League till when they got back in the fall to training camp, preseason games, they put a lot of work in to get themselves to the point at that level of functionality, and it showed up tonight because we were able to really play in an organized, stable way despite the fact that we had new guys out there tonight.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault credits the development of Josh Giddey and Jalen Williams for the team's ability to play in an organized and stable way despite having new players on the floor.

structured.context: Coach Mark Daigneault discusses the development and performance of Josh Giddey and Jalen Williams following a game.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Defensive strategy and execution against Devin Booker
quotes.excerpt: We were able to both play zone and maintain a radar on Booker.
quotes.quote: We had a good awareness of their personnel. We were able to both play zone and maintain a radar on Booker. Obviously, he's a really tough cover and I thought we did a great team job on him tonight, both in man and zone. And then just understanding who we're closing to and what we want to give up, we were able to maintain that man-to-man principle when we zoned them a little bit tonight. So, great focus by the team and great execution.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault praises the Thunder defensive execution against Devin Booker noting the team did a great job maintaining man to man principles while mixing in zone coverage.

structured.context: Coach Mark Daigneault explains the defensive strategy used by the team to contain Devin Booker.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's growth and future potential as a player
quotes.excerpt: He's kind of established that he's a great player and that he's got a really bright future.
quotes.quote: If you look at his zoom out to his whole trajectory as a player, he was pretty functional and impactful even as a rookie player on a very good team before he took an injury that year. And then obviously had almost a linear trajectory last year with the way that he started and finished the season. So, he's established that he's a great player and that he's got a really bright future. Just his physical exertion and his effort on the defensive end and on the offensive end is what stands out to me. It's just how hard he plays, how smart he plays, how skilled he is on both ends.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault highlights the growth of Shai Gilgeous Alexander noting that his physical exertion and effort on both ends of the floor is what stands out most.

structured.context: Coach Mark Daigneault reflects on the career trajectory and development of Shai Gilgeous-Alexander.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's leadership and stability in difficult situations
quotes.excerpt: The stability that we have in these sorts of situations is a huge reflection of the stability he brings.
quotes.quote: He's amazing in just about every situation. His ability to empathize with his teammates and then also lead in the next competitive battle. He just has a great instinct and sense for what's going on environmentally and just knowing what the team needs at this point. And he's honed that. That's the thing that's beautiful about him as a player and as a leader is he's forced himself into this player and leader continuously, and it's really impressive. The stability that we have in these sorts of situations is a huge reflection of the stability that he brings to every situation.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault says the stability the Thunder show in difficult situations is a direct reflection of the leadership Shai Gilgeous Alexander brings to the team.

structured.context: Coach Mark Daigneault praises the leadership qualities and stability provided by Shai Gilgeous-Alexander.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Expectations for officiating fairness and consistency in games
quotes.excerpt: All we want is fairness and consistency, and we expect those guys to run the game.
quotes.quote: I thought Tony and the crew tonight did a good job of managing the game. It's our expectation, all we want is fairness and consistency, and we expect those guys to run the game, and that crew tonight ran the game. We can't control what anybody else does, but we can hope that the officials can manage the game in the way that they did tonight, and I thought they did a good job.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault says he was pleased with the officiating in tonight's game noting that all the team asks for is fairness and consistency.

structured.context: Coach Mark Daigneault comments on the officiating performance during the postgame media availability.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: The team's commitment to making games difficult for star players
quotes.excerpt: We take pride in making it difficult on the great players in the NBA.
quotes.quote: He started on Booker, and I thought he set an important tone there. We take pride in making it difficult on the great players in the NBA, and I think through four games we've done a great job of that. We continued it tonight despite missing really impactful point-of-attack defenders. We did it as a team, but his willingness to take on that challenge and his edge to start the game, I thought had a lot to do with that.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault says the Thunder take pride in making it difficult on the great players in the NBA and believes the team has done a great job of that through the first four games.

structured.context: Coach Mark Daigneault discusses the team's defensive approach and pride in challenging star players like Devin Booker.
